cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Will you carry that box yourself?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. You may leave the hiring to me; I'll get a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says he can carry everything if you hold the door. Is that all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge it open. Tell him he may start; I'll supervise from this chair.

reason: Replace detached status prefaces with permission to hand hiring to A and the final decision to start under A seated supervision; preserve all real causal contributions.
